clock.asof_rule: right edge minus 1ns; only observable_time <= query_time
clock.genuine_bbo_change_age: seconds since latest genuine valid bid/ask change; identical records do not reset
clock.midpoint_change_age: seconds since latest genuine midpoint change
clock.observable_time: observed_at for book_changes; recorded_at only for depth-snapshot placebo
clock.record_age: seconds since latest valid observable BBO record; identical records reset

exposure.collector_liveness_scope: all book-change tokens in event corpus, outcome-independent
future_zero_label_requires: valid target BBO at decision time
target observation envelope extends beyond horizon
next target valid observable record after horizon occurs within 300s
no target invalid/conflict barrier intersects label interval
collector-wide book-change liveness has no >30s gap intersecting label interval

features.family_innovation_E: mean(abs(p_i(t)-p_i(t-30s))) over available same-family peers; target excluded; no zero fill
features.outside_family: all admitted non-target conditions outside target market_family; equal-weight observed aggregates

outside_match_control.k: min(number of valid family peers, number of valid outside-family candidates)

genuine_change.event: bid and/or ask differs from immediately preceding valid observable BBO
genuine_change.known_invalid_or_gap: reset continuity; first later valid state initializes but is not counted as renewal
genuine_change.same_timestamp_conflict: fail timestamp closed and reset continuity barrier

D2_C02.primary_target: any genuine valid target BBO change in (t,t+30]

D3_C03.reason: DORMANT_GRAPH_SUPPORT_FAIL: Hungary PRE has <3 family peers; Peru PRE presidential targets have 8 family peers but only 2 outside-family admitted conditions, so the prespecified same-degree matched non-neighbour control is unavailable without shrinking the graph.

models.D1: ridge linear regression on raw magnitude target
models.discovery_split: chronological first 2/3 train, last 1/3 validation per event/regime; 300s purge and embargo
models.final_refit: same frozen model on all eligible discovery rows after support audit
models.fit_scope: separate by PRE/ACTIVE; discovery only; no market-ID coefficients

multiplicity.slot_p: conservative intersection-union max of valid expected-sign, predictive-gain, and relevant conditional-null component p-values; for replication also max across predesignated testable challenge events

negative_controls: D1 bid/ask translation versus one-sided spread repair diagnostic

nulls.N0: restricted additive baseline with interaction fixed to zero
nulls.N1: joint cross-sectional 300s block residual resampling within event/regime; masks fixed; 600s sensitivity
nulls.N2_D1: restricted no-interaction common-information/asynchronous bootstrap: retain observed E/A/common predictors and masks, jointly resample 300s cross-sectional residual blocks; require moment, age, availability, autocorrelation and common-burst diagnostics before interpretation
nulls.N2_D2_D4: sequential restricted hazard simulation with interaction zero, own duration/count history recomputed from simulated renewals, observed common/outside activity and exposure schedules retained, plus event-block common logit offset resampled from discovery; no family-specific excitation interaction
nulls.invalid_draws: count as exceedances unless a prespecified structural impossibility makes slot untestable

promotion.D1: CONDITIONAL_MAGNITUDE_RESPONSE_SUPPORTED only with sign, frozen loss gain, N2 survival, Holm, support and replication
promotion.D2: CONDITIONAL_QUOTE_RENEWAL_SUPPORTED only with sign, Brier gain, N2 survival, genuine-change measurement, Holm, support and replication
promotion.no_edge: NO_CONDITIONAL_EDGE only for adequately supported D1/D2 failures
promotion.observation_explanation: OBSERVATION_PROCESS_EXPLAINS_RESULT if raw records/same-timestamp/capture null explain effect

replication.country_generalisation: requires at least one testable Colombia event and testable Peru runoff; otherwise not claimed
replication.rule: same expected interaction sign and positive frozen predictive gain in every predesignated testable event used for claim

universe.admission: canonical Yes token present AND 004A2 regime usable
universe.direct_duplicates: exclude only explicit configured equivalent/mechanical duplicate; none inferred from title
universe.family_graph: same exact market_family within event/regime; leave target out; equal weight

weighting.purpose: prevent high-frequency or many-row markets from dominating
weighting.rule: equal event weight; equal block weight within event; equal target weight within block; equal row weight within target-block
